embeds.title: ARTICLE XV — PLAYOFFS AND CONSOLATION
embeds.description:
Six franchises qualify for the championship playoffs.

• Seeds 1 and 2 receive first-round byes
• Opening round: **3 vs. 6** and **4 vs. 5**
• The bracket reseeds after each round
• Quarterfinals: 1 week
• Semifinals: 1 week
• Championship: **2-week cumulative matchup**

If a playoff matchup ends in an exact tie, the **higher seed** advances or wins.

The championship schedule should end approximately six days before the NHL regular season concludes.

The six non-championship teams participate in the consolation bracket. The consolation champion receives the next-season **+$50 FAAB** bonus described in Article IX.
